issue.title: Next UI: Hardware panel
issue.body:
The bottom Hardware panel for the Listen and Record screens, built with the `figma-component` workflow. The Mode toggle and speaker grill are recipes drawn inside the panel, not separate components.

Figma: [Hardware panel](https://www.figma.com/design/VZ23XV2pxvIIAMn12wI4YI/ETEN-x-Fluent?node-id=2411-529) · [Mode toggle](https://www.figma.com/design/VZ23XV2pxvIIAMn12wI4YI/ETEN-x-Fluent?node-id=2409-538) · [Speaker grill](https://www.figma.com/design/VZ23XV2pxvIIAMn12wI4YI/ETEN-x-Fluent?node-id=2409-533)

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `controlSizes.icon20` (Figma Icon/md) is on the theme, added Legacy-first
- [ ] `HardwarePanel` takes the screen's keys in the KeyDeck, then the Mode toggle (Switch between Headphones and Speech) and the speaker grill
- [ ] `modeLocked` locks the toggle for the whole take
- [ ] The panel pads for the gesture bar, and the grill gives way on narrow screens instead of overflowing
- [ ] Gallery demo: the toggle swaps Listen keys (Play · Previous · Next) and Record keys (Record · Play · Eject); recording latches Record and locks the toggle
- [ ] Unit tests, including the toggle haptic and the lock

Needs QA? Yes (haptics and the panel on a real device, including an API 28 phone where the grill renders flat)

Follow-ups: what Eject does is open (`open-questions.md` Q3).
